M: The ward wall. Painted along it, every few feet: STRONGER TODAY. Under some, smaller: (than what?)
I: Long stone barracks, shutters open, full of snoring.
5: THE FURY HALL. From inside: drums, and a lot of shouting, in time.
6: THE STITCHERY. A sign on the door: WALK IT OFF. Under it: (DOCTOR'S ORDERS).
7: THE IRONHOUSE. Bunks, kit, and the quartermaster. KNOCK. FILL IN THE KNOCKING FORM FIRST.
F: The drill yard's rail. Polished smooth by forty years of leaning.
y: A training dummy. Straw and sacking, very battered.
q: A barrel of water for the drill yard. Somebody has written KALDOR'S on it in chalk, and somebody else has added 'WATER'.
c: A lantern on a post, lit. Somebody keeps it burning.
<: The way west, back to the bazaar.

objects.name: Drillmaster Ox
lines: ONE. TWO. …WHAT COMES AFTER TWO. FOUR.
Nobody's ever told him. Nobody's brave enough.

answer: THREE.
THREE. THREE. ONE TWO THREE FOUR.
Forty years. FORTY YEARS. You there! Recruit! You've done more for this yard than any of 'em.

questions.ask: My boot can count higher than you.
answer: YOUR BOOT. ISN'T IN. MY ARMY.
RECRUIT! DROP AND GIVE ME… ONE. TWO. …LOTS.

objects.name: Recruit Rolf
lines: I joined up to impress a girl.
She joined up too. She's my sergeant now. I've never been less impressive.

questions.ask: How do you impress a sergeant?
answer: Hold it the right way up. Kaya says that's step one.
I'm still on step one. It's a big step.
She might. She said 'well done' on Tuesday.
KAYA: I said 'well, done'. As in finished. You'd fallen over.

objects.name: Sergeant Kaya
lines: Rolf. Rolf, you're holding it upside down.
…He joined to impress me. It's working, a bit. Don't tell him.

answer: Three meals and a roof. That was the promise. We get the roof.
Nobody gets paid. You get an axe and a drill master who can't count to three.

questions.ask: Does Ox know what comes after two?
answer: No. And I'm not telling him. He'd make us run four laps instead of two.
Gorm tried once. Apologised halfway through. Ox thought he was saying sorry for three.

questions.ask: Bit soft for a sergeant, aren't you?
answer: RECRUIT. Twenty laps of the yard.
…You're not a recruit. Fine. Twenty laps anyway. Ox'll count. He'll get lost at three.

objects.name: Gorm the Polite
lines: Sorry. Sorry, I'm going to headbutt you now. Sorry.
…Sorry, I've changed my mind. You look nice. Sorry.

answer: My mum was a raider. Very polite raider. 'Sorry for your village.'
The horde says it's bad for morale. I've apologised to the horde. Several times.
I have! Once! A door. It wasn't expecting it.
I sent the door a letter. Sorry, door. I think we're fine now.

objects.name: Bruni
lines: This is my pet rock. His name's Kaldor.
Not after the king. It's a coincidence. He was called Kaldor before the king was.

questions.ask: What does Kaldor the rock do?
answer: He sits. He watches. He judges.
Like the other one. But he's never sent anyone to the Kaloseum. Better king, really. Don't say I said.

questions.ask: That's not a pet. That's a rock.
answer: Shh! He can hear you!
* The rock does nothing. Bruni looks wounded on its behalf.

lines: It's the one in front of you. It looks very pleased with itself.
